title: Meter Operations Standard: Averaging Window for Recent Electricity Usage
content:
# Averaging Window for Recent Electricity Usage — Utility Services Program

**Standard.** For an estimated electricity line of a Utility Services Program account, the recent electricity average on which the estimate rests is taken over a window set by the account's read history and the resident's tenure:

- **Long window.** When at least 6 actual electricity reads are dated fewer than seven whole months before the billing date and the Apartment Home Lease's move-in date lies at least 24 whole months before it, the recent electricity average is the mean of those reads.
- **Occupant default.** When fewer than 3 actual electricity reads are dated fewer than four whole months before the billing date and fewer than 6 are dated fewer than seven whole months before it, the recent electricity average is 190 kWh times the account's billed occupants.
- **Four-month window.** In every other situation the recent electricity average is the standard estimate: the mean of the actual electricity reads dated fewer than four whole months before the billing date.

Each is rounded to 3 decimals; each sum of recorded electricity usage is taken to 2 decimals. The figure 3 is the number of prior actual reads averaged to estimate usage on the programs that bill electricity.

## Decision grid

| Actual reads, last seven months | Whole months since move-in | Actual reads, last four months | Recent electricity average |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6 or more | 24 or more | any | mean of the seven-month reads |
| 6 or more | fewer than 24 | any | four-month mean |
| 5 or fewer | any | 3 or more | four-month mean |
| 5 or fewer | any | 2 or fewer | 190 kWh times billed occupants |

## Cases (hypothetical accounts)

- Seven actual reads in seven months, move-in 30 months ago, reads summing to 4,200.00 kWh: 4,200.00 divided by 7 is 600.000 kWh.
- Two actual reads in four months and four in seven months, 3 billed occupants: 190 times 3 is 570.000 kWh.
- Six actual reads in seven months but move-in 20 months ago, three reads in four months: the four-month mean.
